statements.statement: The patient presented with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms were intermittent and required correlation with potential arrhythmic events
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was performed
The service was indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
Precertification was not obtained prior to the service
The denial reason code is CO-197
